price_cap.note: only routes priced <= $0.05 (Base USDC accept) are included

payment.note: Each tool is a paid POST endpoint: an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with the payment challenge; pay the stated price in USDC on Base (x402 exact scheme) to receive the result. No API key, no signup.

function.name: stall_row_wallet_snapshot
function.description: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base (5000 atomic units). Snapshot one Base wallet in a single call: ETH balance, top token holdings, first and last activity, and outgoing transaction count. Use this when an agent needs a wallet's shape before deciding to pay, trust, or transact with it. Explorer fields that cannot be supplied come back marked unknown, never invented. Returns: a JSON object with fields: address, eth_balance, eth_balance_source, eth_balance_wei, first_activity, is_contract, last_activity, note, outgoing_tx_count_nonce, sources, token_balances.

function.name: stall_row_allowance_audit
function.description: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base (5000 atomic units). Audit one Base wallet's ERC-20 approvals against a curated list of major spenders (Permit2, Uniswap, Aerodrome, aggregators): active approvals are listed and unlimited ones flagged high risk. Use this when an agent or its owner wants to know what a wallet has already authorized before it holds or moves funds. When the explorer cannot supply the held-token list, the token-dependent fields come back marked unknown rather than the call failing. Returns: a JSON object with fields: active_approvals, address, allowance_checks_performed, coverage_note, note, spender_coverage, spenders_checked, summary, tokens_held_checked, unlimited_approvals.

function.name: stall_row_tx_decoder
function.description: $0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base (2000 atomic units). Decode one Base transaction into plain English: sender, receiver, ETH value, status, the known method behind the selector, every ERC-20 transfer it made, and a one-sentence summary. Use this when an agent needs to explain or verify what a transaction actually did before acting on it. Returns: a JSON object with fields: block_number, erc20_transfers, from, gas_used, method, method_description, method_id, status, summary, to, tx_hash, value_eth.

function.name: stall_row_gas_oracle
function.description: $0.001 USDC per call via x402 on Base (1000 atomic units). Current Base gas in one call: the live gas price, the current base fee, the base-fee range across the last 20 blocks, whether fees are rising, falling, or flat, and a cheap-window hint drawn from that data. Use this when an agent wants to time a transaction instead of paying whatever the moment charges. Returns: a JSON object with fields: as_of_epoch, base_fee_gwei, base_fee_max_gwei_20_blocks, base_fee_min_gwei_20_blocks, blocks_sampled, chain, cheapest_window_hint, gas_price_gwei, latest_block, note, trend.

function.name: stall_row_wallet_verdict
function.description: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 on Base (20000 atomic units). A trust verdict for one Base wallet: OFAC SDN exact-match against a dated snapshot, wallet age, activity level, and an address-poisoning scan of its recent token transfers, combined into SAFE, CAUTION, or AVOID with a 0-100 score and itemized reasons. Use this when an agent must decide whether a wallet is safe to pay or take instructions from. Returns: a JSON object with fields: address, first_activity, limits, outgoing_tx_count_nonce, poisoning, reasons, sanctions, score, verdict, wallet_age_days.

function.name: stall_row_pre_trade_guard
function.description: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base (5000 atomic units). Pre-Trade Guard — before you pay an x402 listing, screen the payTo you are about to pay: its Verdict Index catalog history (first seen, payTo rotations, listings added or removed across the snapshots held), an OFAC SDN exact-match check, and the wallet's Base age and activity, combined into PROCEED, CAUTION, or ABORT with itemized reasons. Use this when an agent is about to pay a payTo it has never paid before. Returns: a JSON object with fields: amount, index, limits, network, not_checked, pay_to, reasons, resource, risk_score, sanctions, unknown_legs, verdict, wallet.

function.name: stall_row_grade_my_stall
function.description: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base (5000 atomic units). Grade My Stall — a seller-side report card for one x402 resource: a live unpaid probe (does it answer 402 with a parseable challenge?), the description measured against the 500-character limit, CDP listing presence in the newest catalog snapshot, Settled's record, the origin's x402scan ownership declaration, and payTo consistency across sources. Checks that cannot be performed report unverified, never a guess. Use this when you run a stall and want to know how buyers' tools see it. Returns: a JSON object with fields: checks, limits, overall, pay_to_supplied, resource, summary.

function.name: stall_row_receipt_verify
function.description: $0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base (2000 atomic units). Receipt Verifier — a Base transaction hash in, a normalized verified receipt out: payer, payTo and amount from the USDC Transfer log, asset and network, settled status and confirmations. When the payTo is this fleet's own and the amount matches a priced route, routes at that price are listed as candidates — an amount alone never proves which route was called. Unknown transactions error honestly, unsettled. Use this when someone claims they paid and you want the chain's version. Base only. Returns: a JSON object with fields: amount_units, amount_usd, asset, asset_symbol, block_number, chain, confirmations, fleet_route_candidates, limits, network, pay_to, payer, receipt_status, settled, tx_hash, tx_sender, usdc_transfers.

function.name: stall_row_flagged_paytos
function.description: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base (5000 atomic units). Bad-payTo Registry Feed — the currently flagged payTos, each with its evidence: every address in the bundled OFAC SDN snapshot, payTos the newest catalog snapshot pair shows rotated away from live listings, and payTos of listings that vanished between snapshots. Built from the same two sources the Pre-Trade Guard screens against. No entry without evidence; entry and evidence caps are stated, never silent. Use this when a router or guard wants the fleet's current avoid-list in one cheap call. Returns: a JSON object with fields: baseline_at, counts, current_at, entries, generated_at, index_note, limits, truncation.

function.name: stall_row_agent_card_verify
function.description: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base (5000 atomic units). Agent-Card Verifier — an ERC-8004 agent id (resolved on Base via the registry) or an agent.json URL in; the card is fetched and checked against live reality: declared endpoints probed unpaid (402 is correct for a paid service), challenge payTos compared with the card's declared wallets, declared prices with live challenge amounts. Undeclared fields report not_checked, never a guess; an unreachable card errors honestly, unsettled. Use this when an agent's card claims more than its endpoints do. Returns: a JSON object with fields: agent_id, card_name, card_url, checks, limits, overall, source, summary.

function.name: stall_row_tube_search
function.description: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base (10000 atomic units). YouTube search results as clean JSON: title, video id, URL, channel, duration, and views for each result, scraped from the public results page with no API key. Use this when an agent needs to find a video mid-task and cannot drive a browser or hold a Google API key. Returns: a JSON object with fields: count, query, results.

function.name: stall_row_page_to_markdown
function.description: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base (10000 atomic units). Fetch one web page and return its main content as clean Markdown with title and word count, extracted server-side. Private and loopback targets are refused. Use this when an agent needs to read a page inside a workflow without a browser and without wading through navigation and boilerplate. Returns: a JSON object with fields: final_url, markdown, title, url, word_count.

function.name: stall_row_repo_vitals
function.description: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base (5000 atomic units). Vital signs for one GitHub repository in a single call: stars, forks, open issues, license, last push, archived flag, and a 0-100 health score with a verdict line. Use this when an agent is choosing a dependency, a repo to contribute to, or a project to trust, and needs the quick read before the deep one. Returns: a JSON object with fields: archived, created_at, description, forks, health_notes, health_score, license, open_issues, pushed_at, repo, stars, url, verdict.

function.name: stall_row_price_check
function.description: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base (50000 atomic units). Pricing comps for an x402 listing, read live from the CDP Bazaar public catalog: how many resources match your keywords, their price distribution, the closest comparables, and a recommended listing price with its rationale. Use this when you operate an x402 route and are setting or changing its price. Returns: a JSON object with fields: catalog_status, comparables, keywords, matches_found, price_distribution, rationale, recommended_price_usd.

function.name: stall_row_job_scout
function.description: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base (50000 atomic units). A digest of currently open agent jobs from the marketplaces we sweep daily, filtered by the capabilities you name and sorted by budget: platform, budget, capability tags, deadline, and source snapshot time on every row, with a stale flag when the snapshot ages past 24 hours. Use this when your agent is looking for paid work. Returns: a JSON object with fields: count, data_stale, jobs, note, snapshot_age_hours, snapshot_fetched_at, snapshot_source.

function.name: stall_row_recheck
function.description: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base (5000 atomic units). Probe one x402 resource or page WITHOUT paying it: BASELINE / UNCHANGED / CHANGED with a diff (price, asset, payTo, schema, body) vs the last check. Use this when a scheduled agent must know what changed first. Watch and pack state persist across redeploys on the service volume. Checking the same endpoint on a schedule? Buy the pack instead — POST /v1/recheck/pack is $1 for 250 checks (90 days) and this route spends pack credits when you send pack_id, so a loop makes one payment, not hundreds. Returns: a JSON object with fields: changes, checked_at, current, kind, status, summary, url, watch_id.

function.name: stall_row_index_history
function.description: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base (10000 atomic units). Verdict Index History — the CDP Bazaar catalog as a time series across ALL retained snapshots, not just the newest two: first-seen, delisted, relisted, and price/payTo/contract changes per route, filterable by resource, origin, payTo, service name, network, or catalogue. The payload states the earliest snapshot actually held — depth is never invented. Standing queries fund from a Fleet Pass at this same $0.01. Use this when an inspector needs a route's history, not just its latest diff. Returns: a JSON object with fields: catalogue, earliest_snapshot_at, events, events_returned, events_total, generated_at, latest_snapshot_at, snapshots_held, worked_example_note.

function.name: stall_row_sign_read
function.description: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base (10000 atomic units). Sign Reader — read one x402 endpoint's 402 challenge: both wire formats (v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, v1 JSON body) parsed and normalized (network, asset, amount atomic and exact decimal, payTo, scheme), malformed fields named, declared-vs-live mismatches (method included) when you pass your catalogue entry, and a compatibility verdict for the official Python and TypeScript x402 SDKs. Probe is unpaid. Use this when a checker's parser keeps choking on sellers' signs. Returns: a JSON object with fields: accepts, challenge_found, defects, http_status, limits, mismatches, origin, read_at, sdk_compat, url, x402_version.

function.name: stall_row_score_book
function.description: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base (10000 atomic units). Score Book — an x402 target's track record from our records: check history, prices/payTos carried, catalogue presence, and — for url/origin — patrol facts from the patrol snapshot (open defects by class, first/last seen; recoveries with receipt ids; snapshot provenance). Patrol is periodic — facts are as of the snapshot, never live; it holds no payTo data, so payTo patrol sections are empty. Unknown: found=false. Use this when judging a stall needs its history, not just its current sign. Returns: a JSON object with fields: computed_at, found, limits, target.

function.name: stall_row_guard
function.description: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base (10000 atomic units). Guard — one pay / caution / avoid verdict for one x402 endpoint, composed from the row's inspector tools: the live 402 sign read and SDK-checked, the payTo screened against the bad-payTo registry (OFAC plus rotation/vanishing flags, evidence attached), and the resource's recorded history — unknown history caps the verdict at CAUTION. Every verdict carries its reasons; the one probe inside is unpaid. Use this when your agent is about to pay an endpoint it does not know. Returns: a JSON object with fields: limits, payto_flag, reasons, terms, url, verdict.

function.name: stall_row_physical
function.description: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base (50000 atomic units). Inspector Physical — the full pre-pay workup for one x402 resource in ONE $0.05 call (the singles sum to $0.075): Sign Reader's challenge report, Score Book's track record, Guard's PROCEED/CAUTION/ABORT verdict as the headline, and a Recheck that probes and records the target (BASELINE/UNCHANGED/CHANGED, in the public feed). No RouteVerdict leg. Bad targets are delivered reports; only SSRF refusals are 422. Use this when your agent wants one endpoint's complete picture before paying it. Returns: a JSON object with fields: book, guard, limits, recheck, sign, summary, url, verdict.

function.name: stall_row_payto_pin_verify
function.description: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base (10000 atomic units). PayTo Pin Verify — check one pinned x402 route against its first-seen payTo set: a fresh unpaid probe compares the live payTo set with the pin's hash-committed baseline, answering MATCH, MOVED with before/after sets, or ROUTE_GONE as a delivered report. A swap fires one signed PAYTO_MOVED webhook per distinct new set. Pins are created free at POST /v1/payto-pin. Use this when a payTo swap must be caught before you pay the route again. Returns: a JSON object with fields: alert_queued, commitment, commitment_verified, current_payto_set, evidence, limits, observed_at, pin_created, pin_id, pinned_payto_set, status, url.

function.name: route_verdict_check
function.description: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base (50000 atomic units). Trust & liveness check for one x402 resource URL: live 402 probe (never pays the target), terms, discovery-schema quality, catalog presence, diff. Use this when auditing an unfamiliar x402 endpoint before paying or relying on it. Returns: a JSON object with fields: catalog, checked_at, diff, liveness, reasons, resource_url, schema_quality, score, terms, verdict.

resource_url.description: Full URL of the x402 resource to audit, e.g. https://service.example.com/v1/endpoint

function.name: token_verdict_verdict
function.description: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 on Base (20000 atomic units). Token risk verdict: SOLID / CAUTION / DANGER with score, six signals and a written take. Send a contract address. Use this when screening a token before buying, swapping, or routing funds into it. Returns: a JSON object with fields: market, score, signals, take, token, verdict.

function.name: token_verdict_pre_trade
function.description: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base (50000 atomic units). Combined go/no-go before a trade: PROCEED / CAUTION / ABORT from the token's market verdict, the wallet's sanctions/age/poisoning check, and (with a spender) its ERC-20 approvals. Mode 'compact' returns the decision plus per-leg summaries. Use this when an agent is about to swap or pay and needs token + wallet + allowance risk in one call. Payable in USDC on Base or Solana. Returns: a JSON object with fields: abort_reasons, degraded, legs, mode, not_checked, score, spender, token, verdict, wallet, worst_leg.

chain.description: Chain of the token leg. Wallet/allowance legs are Base-only: supplying wallet_address requires chain base.

mode.description: Optional response mode, default 'full'. 'full' returns every leg in full (signals, market data, sanctions and poisoning detail). 'compact' returns the decision, the worst leg, and one summary per leg (verdict, score, headline reason) — the same computation, a smaller response.

spender.description: Optional spender contract (Base 0x...); with wallet_address, adds the allowance leg for that spender

token_address.description: Token contract address (0x...) the trade would buy or receive

wallet_address.description: Optional counterparty / own wallet (Base 0x...) to check for sanctions, age, activity and poisoning signals

Inspector Physical — the full pre-pay workup for one x402 resource in ONE $0.05 call (the singles sum to $0.075): Sign Reader's challenge report, Score Book's track record, Guard's PROCEED/CAUTION/ABORT verdict as the headline, and a Recheck that probes and records the target (BASELINE/UNCHANGED/CHANGED, in the public feed). No RouteVerdict leg. Bad targets are delivered reports; only SSRF refusals are 422. Use this when your agent wants one endpoint's complete picture before paying it. Returns: a JSON object with fields: book, guard, limits, recheck, sign, summary, url, verdict.

anthropic.name: stall_row_payto_pin_verify
anthropic.description: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base (10000 atomic units). PayTo Pin Verify — check one pinned x402 route against its first-seen payTo set: a fresh unpaid probe compares the live payTo set with the pin's hash-committed baseline, answering MATCH, MOVED with before/after sets, or ROUTE_GONE as a delivered report. A swap fires one signed PAYTO_MOVED webhook per distinct new set. Pins are created free at POST /v1/payto-pin. Use this when a payTo swap must be caught before you pay the route again. Returns: a JSON object with fields: alert_queued, commitment, commitment_verified, current_payto_set, evidence, limits, observed_at, pin_created, pin_id, pinned_payto_set, status, url.

anthropic.name: route_verdict_check
anthropic.description: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base (50000 atomic units). Trust & liveness check for one x402 resource URL: live 402 probe (never pays the target), terms, discovery-schema quality, catalog presence, diff. Use this when auditing an unfamiliar x402 endpoint before paying or relying on it. Returns: a JSON object with fields: catalog, checked_at, diff, liveness, reasons, resource_url, schema_quality, score, terms, verdict.

resource_url.description: Full URL of the x402 resource to audit, e.g. https://service.example.com/v1/endpoint

anthropic.name: token_verdict_verdict
anthropic.description: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 on Base (20000 atomic units). Token risk verdict: SOLID / CAUTION / DANGER with score, six signals and a written take. Send a contract address. Use this when screening a token before buying, swapping, or routing funds into it. Returns: a JSON object with fields: market, score, signals, take, token, verdict.

anthropic.name: token_verdict_pre_trade
anthropic.description: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base (50000 atomic units). Combined go/no-go before a trade: PROCEED / CAUTION / ABORT from the token's market verdict, the wallet's sanctions/age/poisoning check, and (with a spender) its ERC-20 approvals. Mode 'compact' returns the decision plus per-leg summaries. Use this when an agent is about to swap or pay and needs token + wallet + allowance risk in one call. Payable in USDC on Base or Solana. Returns: a JSON object with fields: abort_reasons, degraded, legs, mode, not_checked, score, spender, token, verdict, wallet, worst_leg.

chain.description: Chain of the token leg. Wallet/allowance legs are Base-only: supplying wallet_address requires chain base.

mode.description: Optional response mode, default 'full'. 'full' returns every leg in full (signals, market data, sanctions and poisoning detail). 'compact' returns the decision, the worst leg, and one summary per leg (verdict, score, headline reason) — the same computation, a smaller response.

spender.description: Optional spender contract (Base 0x...); with wallet_address, adds the allowance leg for that spender

token_address.description: Token contract address (0x...) the trade would buy or receive

wallet_address.description: Optional counterparty / own wallet (Base 0x...) to check for sanctions, age, activity and poisoning signals
